_comment: Authorized testing context. Copy to engagement.json and edit. This example points at the bundled demo target on 127.0.0.1 and opts into private ranges (LAB ONLY). For a real engagement, set a public staging host, keep allow_private_ranges false, and put real test-account tokens in .env and reference them from personas as ${VAR} (resolved at load time; an unset variable withholds the header and blocks the run rather than sending a credential that cannot authenticate).
